outcome: cord blood parameters (Haemoglobin, haematocrit, platelet, calcium and bilirubin)
cohort: 100 neonates born to mothers with and without gestational diabetes mellitus in a tertiary care armed forces hospital.
finding: Neonates of diabetic mothers had a significantly higher percentage of preterm births, NICU admission, hyperbilirubinemia, hypoglycaemia, and polycythemia compared to neonates of non-diabetic mothers, while anthropometric and cord blood parameters were comparable between the groups.
mod_finding: Mothers with GDM had a significantly higher rate of emergency LSCS (66%) compared to mothers without GDM (32%).
